rationale: The stock is in a no-man's land: it sits below session VWAP ($12.79) near the bottom of its range, which favors bears, but it has stabilized 3% above the low with tight, low-volume one-minute candles drifting slightly upward and price pinned right on the 9-EMA — signs the selling has paused rather than resumed. With no news to explain the -19% gap, an unknown float (squeeze/borrow risk), and midday volume drying up, neither a breakdown-continuation short nor a VWAP-reclaim long has confirmation; the clean mechanical triggers would be a break under ~$12.03 to short or a reclaim of ~$12.79 to go long, and neither has happened. Standing aside until one of those levels resolves carries the better risk/reward than initiating into balance, especially while already down on the session.
